capabilities.rationale: Registered source producer for PR Treasury IVU/SUT monthly collections. It fetches the live Hacienda PDFs and materializes data/staging/processed/pr_hacienda_sut_ivu.csv; the resulting rows reach operators through the existing public-money-intelligence-dashboard capability, exactly like every other ingested source, rather than through a surface of their own. Its CLI is an implementation surface for scheduled and operator-initiated materialization, not a user-facing workflow, and it promotes nothing automatically.
